<thought>To find the appropriate template, I will search the template catalog using the first precursor SMILES as the target molecule and filter by the functional groups formed and broken that characterize the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons reaction (formation of an aliphatic carboxylic acid and an alkene, breaking of C‑P and C‑O bonds, and formation of a C‑C bond). This should return the template ID that, when applied retrosynthetically, yields the listed precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid", "C-C double bond"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
